items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: There was a dancer when we was down at Baron's, named Yonder.

ctx.x: And so, I worked on that line. Well, when I left, I got a new experience, because along comes a man -- was it there? Wait a minute now. No, I'm ahead of my story. Let me tell you something that happened. There was a dancer when we was down at Baron's, named Yonder.
